argv: # Dotted keys deep-merge across sources (the help text example).
# An empty source parses to nothing and leaves the seed value untouched.
# Number formatting parity: exponent, fraction, and negative zero.
# util.deep refuses the prototype-reaching keys at every level, an
# element the overlay APPENDS to an array included: TypeScript merges
# every index the overlay names, so a slot past the end of the base is
# merged into the `undefined` already there rather than taken whole.
# Object keys print in SOURCE order, not sorted (JSON.stringify parity).
# A base-prefixed integer past int64 keeps its exact mathematical value,
# rounded once to float64 (parser 0.8.1 / jsonic 0.6.1). Not clamped to
# MaxInt64, and not wrapped negative by a Go float->int64 conversion.
# ECMA-262 6.1.6.1.20 Number::toString, not the host language's own
# float formatter: fixed notation from 1e-6 up to just under 1e21, an
# exponent outside that range, and a shortest-form TIE broken to the EVEN
# digit rather than away from zero. Measured under Node.
